page_title_chirho: Perffection · A home for your business online
page_description_chirho: Useful software for the business you are building. Begin with a beautiful website; discover the Cairn-powered vision for business intelligence, connected work and accountable AI. Opening by invitation.

hero_chirho.mark_chirho: A home for your business online
hero_chirho.lead_chirho: A good website is a beginning. We’re building a home for the software that helps you run your business, understand it, and serve people well. Beautiful on the outside, with care and accountability in the foundations.
hero_chirho.quiet_note_chirho: Our first step is a business website. Opening by invitation.

platform_chirho.body_chirho: A business has people to look after, work to keep moving and decisions to make. Perffection’s destination is software that brings those things together, with AI to help and you in charge. The website is our first release. Here is the wider work we’re building toward.

examples_chirho.body_chirho: Which work pays its way? Where are customers getting stuck? Bring your figures into view, ask useful questions and see what is working. Business intelligence that helps you make a considered decision, not another dashboard to babysit.

Customer records, enquiries, orders and follow-ups belong beside one another. We want the software to fit the way you work, and connect with tools you already use, rather than make you copy the same facts from place to place.

AI could help prepare your marketing, notice a missed follow-up or build a useful tool for your team. You should be able to see what it proposes and choose what it may do, with more time left for the people you serve.

platform_chirho.note_chirho: These wider tools are not open to customers yet. We’re beginning with the website, and building toward a business platform on Cairn, the engine underneath Perffection.

secure_chirho.heading_chirho: Trust should have something to stand on.
secure_chirho.body_chirho: When software touches your work, trust matters more than a reassuring badge. Cairn confines application code, checks its permitted actions and keeps signed records. Perffection brings that foundation to the person running the business. In today’s website release, your drafts are private and publishing is your decision.

points_chirho.body_chirho: Saving a draft does not publish it. You choose when your words go live.
Publishing leaves a signed record of the version released. There is something to inspect, not just a promise that it happened.
Cairn runs app code without ambient access to files or the network. Effects go through declared, reviewed doors.
Your saved drafts stay behind your sign-in. Your published page is public, so choose what you share with care.

points_chirho.title_chirho: A way to put things right
points_chirho.body_chirho: You can restore earlier published words. That is useful, but it cannot take back what somebody has already seen.

abundant_chirho.heading_chirho: Let the tools serve the work.
abundant_chirho.body_chirho: Good software should help you notice what needs attention, make a wiser choice and take care of people. That is the direction of our business tools. The first step is simpler: a welcoming page that says what you do and makes it easy to reach you.
abundant_chirho.proof_chirho: More activity is not always better work. We want the platform to make useful things clearer and needless chores smaller, without promising what your business will earn.

path_chirho.body_chirho: Available by invitation today: your website, your services and a clear way for people to get in touch.
Planned: bring customer information and the work you do for them into the same place, with useful connections to your existing tools.

path_chirho.title_chirho: A clearer view of your business
path_chirho.body_chirho: Planned: business intelligence and AI assistance to help you spot what matters and consider the next good step.

easy_chirho.body_chirho: Today you can make a business website, one question at a time, with an example in every box. Preview your words, save them privately and publish when you are ready. It is a modest beginning, made with care, and not the limit of what we’re building.

decide_chirho.body_chirho: Your words, your services and how to reach you, in your own voice.
Nothing reaches your visitors until you press Publish.
Choose from the earlier versions offered in your publishing history.

handled_chirho.body_chirho: Type your business name once and it appears at the top of your page, in the footer and on the browser tab. Type your number once and it becomes a tap-to-call button.
We handle hosting, HTTPS and upkeep. You do not need to install or maintain plugins for this page.
Every page lays itself out for phones, tablets and computers, and stays light so it opens quickly.
The page API is built and tested locally. Opening it to your own assistant still needs a key that enforces the limits you choose. That door is not open to customers yet.

items_chirho.answer_chirho: No. The website is our first available release. Our destination is a business platform: customer records, operations, business intelligence and AI-built tools, on Cairn’s accountable foundation. Those wider tools are not open to customers yet.

items_chirho.question_chirho: Do I need to be good with computers?
items_chirho.answer_chirho: No. If you can fill in a form, you can make your page. Every box has an example, and you can take it one question at a time.

items_chirho.question_chirho: What if I make a mistake?
items_chirho.answer_chirho: A saved draft stays private until you publish it. Earlier published content can be restored from the versions offered in your history. Restoring content does not erase something a visitor has already seen.
That is being prepared. We have tested the page API locally, but customer keys are not available yet. Each assistant needs a key whose limits are actually enforced before we can offer that access.

Published pages use HTTPS, tell browsers to refuse scripts and have no plugins for you to patch. Cairn also supplies the controlled execution and signed publishing records underneath. None of that makes a service unbreakable; looking after it remains our responsibility.
You do. You can download a copy of your page's words and details whenever you like.

Our direction is free building and hosting, with funded AI use kept separate. Production prices and purchase arrangements are not open yet; we will explain any charge before asking you to agree to it.
Perffection is opening to small businesses by invitation, a few at a time. If you have an invitation, sign in and start with your name.

closing_chirho.heading_chirho: Tell us about the work you do.
closing_chirho.body_chirho: We’re opening the first website release by invitation and building the wider platform with care. Tell us about your business and what would genuinely help. If you already have an invitation, welcome: sign in and begin.
closing_chirho.invitation_note_chirho: “Let all your things be done with charity.” 1 Corinthians 16:14
closing_chirho.because_chirho: We follow Jesus Christ. We want this work to be useful, truthful and done with love. Technology should help you serve people, not make you a servant to it. With God’s help, that is the work we hope to do.
closing_chirho.verse_chirho: Establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou.
